meaning:
Jashubi-lehem = "returner of bread"
a descendant of Shelah, the son of Judah by Bath-shua the Canaanitess
Another name of bet le.chem (בֵּית לֶ֫חֶם "Bethlehem" H1035G)

elsewhere.note: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient.
